wargear.name: Kustom Force Field
wargear.text: A model with this Wargear and any attached unit have a 5+ Invulnerable save.

wargear.name: Attack Squig
wargear.text: A model with this Wargear has +1 to its Attacks (A) characteristic.

wargear.name: Force Field
wargear.text: A unit with this Wargear has a 5+ Invulnerable save.

wargear.name: Ammo Runt
wargear.text: Once per game, in the Shooting Phase a model equipped with this wargear gains the Linked special rule on all Pistol, Assault and Rapid Fire weapons it is equipped with until the end of the Phase.

wargear.name: Cybork Body
wargear.text: A model with this Wargear gains the Feel no Pain (6+) special rule.

wargear.name: Grot Oiler
wargear.text: Once per game, in your Movement Phase a model equipped with this wargear may immediately attempt to perform the "I Can Fix It!" Machine Rite (see Machine Rites) as if it had the Battle-Smith (x) special rule.

wargear.name: Fightin Juice
wargear.text: A model with this wargear and any attached unit gains the Feel No Pain (5+) special rule.

wargear.name: Grot Orderly
wargear.text: Once per game in either the Shooting Phase or Combat Phase, a model equipped with this wargear may re-roll Feel no Pain rolls until the end of the current phase in which this effect is declared.

wargear.name: Shokk-Boosta
wargear.text: A model with this wargear and any attached unit gains the Deep Strike special rule.

wargear.name: Distraction Grot
wargear.text: Once per game, a model equipped with this wargear may ignore 1 wound allocated to it by a weapon that does not have the Spray, Blast (x) special rules.

wargear.name: Scrap Armour
wargear.text: This confers a 6+ Armour Save.

wargear.name: Mega Armour
wargear.text: This confers a 2+ Armour Save and 6+ Invulnerable Save. The model equipped with this Wargear gains the Relentless, Bulky (2) and Slow & Purposeful Special Rules.

wargear.name: He'avy Armour
wargear.text: This confers a 4+ Armour save.

wargear.name: Thick Armour
wargear.text: This confers a 3+ Armour save.

wargear.name: Rokkit Pack
wargear.text: A model equipped with this Wargear increases its Movement (M) characteristic to 12". The equipped model gains the Hammer of Wrath (1), Fly, and Deep Strike special rules.

wargear.name: Deff Kopta
wargear.text: A unit that is equipped with a Deff Kopta becomes a Jetbike type unit and gains all associated benefits. In addition, it gains +1 to its Toughness (T) and Wounds (w) Characteristics. A Deff Kopta is equipped with a Linked Rokkit. The unit gains the Fly special rule.

wargear.name: War Bike
wargear.text: A unit that is equipped with a Bike becomes a Bike type unit and gains all associated benefits. In addition, it gains +1 to its Toughness (T) Characteristics. A War Bike is equipped with Linked Big Shoota.

wargear.name: Squigasaur
wargear.text: A unit that is equipped with a Squigasaur becomes a Cavalry type unit and gains all associated benefits. In addition, it gains +1 to its Strength (S) and Toughness (T) Characteristics. A Squigasaur is equipped with a Close Combat Weapon.

wargear.name: Wartrike
wargear.text: A unit that is equipped with a Wartrike becomes a Bike type unit and gains all associated benefits. In addition, it gains +1 to its Toughness (T) and Wounds (W) Characteristics. A Wartrike is equipped with a Burna.

wargear.name: Squighog
wargear.text: A unit that is equipped with a Squighog becomes a Cavalry type unit and gains all associated benefits. In addition, it gains +1 to its Toughness (T) Characteristics. A Squighog resolves Hammer of Wrath (x) attacks at AP4.

wargear.name: Dakkarig
wargear.text: A unit that is equipped with a Dakkarig becomes a Walker type unit and gains all associated benefits. In addition, it gains +2 to its Toughness (T) and Wounds (W) Characteristics. A Dakkarig is equipped with a Kustom Force Field, Rokkits and a Deffgun.

wargear.name: Squig-hide Tires
wargear.text: A unit with this wargear may re-roll Dangerous Terrain tests.

wargear.name: Dirty Gubbinz
wargear.text: A model equipped with this Wargear can set to smoke instead of Overwatching. Until the start of its next turn, the model gains a 4+ Cover Save.

wargear.name: Stompamatic Pistons
wargear.text: A unit with this wargear gains the Sprint (1) special rule.

wargear.name: Shokka Hull
wargear.text: A unit with this wargear increases their Hammer of Wrath (x) value by 1.

wargear.name: The Super Cybork Body
wargear.text: One unit in your army with the Character special rule that does not have the Unique keyword and no other Relic Wargear may purchase this wargear. A model equipped with this Relic gains the Feel no Pain (4+) special rule.

wargear.name: Da Fixer Upperz
wargear.text: One unit in your army with the Character special rule that does not have the Unique keyword and no other Relic Wargear may purchase this wargear. A model equipped with this Relic gains the Battle-Smith (1) special rule and knows the I Can Fix It! Machine Rite. If the bearer already has the Battle-Smith (x) special rule, increase the value of (x) by 1.

wargear.name: Da Lucky Stikk
wargear.text: One unit in your army with the Character special rule that does not have the Unique keyword and no other Relic Wargear may purchase this wargear. A model equipped with this Relic may re-roll 1 Hit Roll, Wound Roll, Penetration Roll or Save Roll per Phase.

wargear.name: Da Krushin Armour
wargear.text: One unit in your army with the Character special rule that does not have the Unique keyword and no other Relic Wargear may purchase this wargear. A model equipped with this Relic gains the Hammer of Wrath (3) special rule and a 2+ Armour Save. Once per game, a model with this Relic can re-roll a failed Charge roll.

wargear.name: Bad Moons Banner
wargear.text: All Bad Moons units within 12" may re-roll Pinning and Panic tests.

wargear.name: Nazdreg's Know-Wats
wargear.text: This unit and any attached unit gain the Deep Strike special rule.

wargear.name: Big Revva
wargear.text: This counts as a Bike and gains all associated benefits (included above). The unit gains +1 to your units Toughness (T) characteristics. The unit is equipped with Psyko-Gatler.

wargear.name: Lash
wargear.text: A unit that includes a model with this wargear gains the Sprint (1) special rule.

wargear.name: Squig Hound
wargear.text: A unit that includes a model with this wargear gains the Breaking Heads special rule.

wargear.name: Gold Toof Armour
wargear.text: A model with this wargear has a 3+ Armour save and a 4+ Invulnerable save.

wargear.name: Da Red Koat
wargear.text: A model with this wargear has a 3+ Invulnerable save.

wargear.name: Da Kap of Da Revolushun
wargear.text: All units with the Grot Mob Special rule which can draw visibility to this model count as Leadership (LD) 10.
